name: Pranamya Shirasa
text:
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं गौरीपुत्रं विनायकम् ।
भक्तावासं स्मरेन्नित्यमायुःकामार्थसिद्धये ॥
meaning: Bowing the head to Vinayaka, the son of Gauri, who dwells with his devotees, one should remember him daily, for long life and the fulfilment of aims.
purpose: The opening verse of the Sankatanashana Ganesha Stotram.
when: At the opening of a practice.
